listing.title: My First Clothes Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Things to Wear – T-Shirt, Dress, Socks, Shoes & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly things to wear!

Little hands color 30 pages of clothes, from a T-shirt, a dress and a pair of socks to a sun hat, a hoodie and a backpack. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, most with happy faces, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Tops: T-Shirt, Shirt, Hoodie, Jacket, Coat and Bathrobe
  • Dresses and play clothes: Dress, Skirt, Pants, Shorts, Overalls, Swimsuit, Tutu, Apron and Bib
  • Shoes and socks: Socks, Shoes, Sandals, Flip-Flops, Ballet Shoes and a Cowboy Boot
  • Hats: Sun Hat, Top Hat and Party Hat
  • Warm, dressy and carry-along things: Scarf, Gloves, Bow Tie, Necktie, Backpack and Purse
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
